verses.en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
verses.pt: Ora, estes são os nomes dos filhos de Israel, que entraram no Egito; entraram com Jacó, cada um com a sua família:
verses.en_web: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt; every man and his family came with Jacob.

verses.en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.pt: Rúben, Simeão, Levi, e Judá;
verses.en_web: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.en_bbe: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;

verses.en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.pt: Issacar, Zebulom e Benjamim;
verses.en_web: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.en_bbe: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;

verses.en: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.pt: Dã e Naftali, Gade e Aser.
verses.en_web: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
verses.en_bbe: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

verses.en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
verses.pt: Todas as almas, pois, que procederam da coxa de Jacó, foram setenta; José, porém, já estava no Egito.
verses.en_web: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
verses.en_bbe: All the offspring of Jacob were seventy persons: and Joseph had come to Egypt before them.

verses.en: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
verses.pt: Morreu, pois, José, e todos os seus irmãos, e toda aquela geração.
verses.en_web: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph came to his end, and all his brothers, and all that generation.

verses.en: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.pt: Depois os filhos de Israel frutificaram e aumentaram muito, multiplicaram-se e tornaram-se sobremaneira fortes, de modo que a terra se encheu deles.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel were fertile, increasing very greatly in numbers and in power; and the land was full of them.

verses.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
verses.pt: Entrementes se levantou sobre o Egito um novo rei, que não conhecera a José.
verses.en_web: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: Now a new king came to power in Egypt, who had no knowledge of Joseph.

verses.en: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
verses.pt: Disse ele ao seu povo: Eis que o povo de Israel é mais numeroso e mais forte do que nos.
verses.en_web: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to his people, See, the people of Israel are greater in number and in power than we are:

verses.en: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
verses.pt: Eia, usemos de astúcia para com ele, para que não se multiplique, e aconteça que, vindo guerra, ele também se ajunte com os nossos inimigos, e peleje contra nós e se retire da terra.
verses.en_web: Come, let us deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies, and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”
verses.en_bbe: Let us take care for fear that their numbers may become even greater, and if there is a war, they may be joined with those who are against us, and make an attack on us, and go up out of the land.

verses.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.pt: Portanto puseram sobre eles feitores, para os afligirem com suas cargas. Assim os israelitas edificaram para Faraó cidades armazéns, Pitom e Ramessés.
verses.en_web: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.
verses.en_bbe: So they put overseers of forced work over them, in order to make their strength less by the weight of their work. And they made store-towns for Pharaoh, Pithom and Raamses.

verses.en: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Mas quanto mais os egípcios afligiam o povo de Israel, tanto mais este se multiplicava e se espalhava; de maneira que os egípcios se enfadavam por causa dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They were grieved because of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But the more cruel they were to them, the more their number increased, till all the land was full of them. And the children of Israel were hated by the Egyptians.

verses.en: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
verses.pt: Por isso os egípcios faziam os filhos de Israel servir com dureza;
verses.en_web: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,
verses.en_bbe: And they gave the children of Israel even harder work to do:

verses.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
verses.pt: assim lhes amarguravam a vida com pesados serviços em barro e em tijolos, e com toda sorte de trabalho no campo, enfim com todo o seu serviço, em que os faziam servir com dureza.
verses.en_web: and they made their lives bitter with hard service, in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.
verses.en_bbe: And made their lives bitter with hard work, making building-material and bricks, and doing all sorts of work in the fields under the hardest conditions.

verses.en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
verses.pt: Falou o rei do Egito às parteiras das hebréias, das quais uma se chamava Sifrá e a outra Puá,
verses.en_web: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew women who gave help at the time of childbirth (the name of the one was Shiphrah and the name of the other Puah),

verses.en: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
verses.pt: dizendo: Quando ajudardes no parto as hebréias, e as virdes sobre os assentos, se for filho, matá-lo-eis; mas se for filha, viverá.
verses.en_web: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool; if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”
verses.en_bbe: When you are looking after the Hebrew women in childbirth, if it is a son you are to put him to death; but if it is a daughter, she may go on living.

verses.en: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
verses.pt: As parteiras, porém, temeram a Deus e não fizeram como o rei do Egito lhes ordenara, antes conservavam os meninos com vida.
verses.en_web: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
verses.en_bbe: But the women had the fear of God, and did not do as the king of Egypt said, but let the male children go on living.

verses.en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
verses.pt: Pelo que o rei do Egito mandou chamar as parteiras e as interrogou: Por que tendes feito isto e guardado os meninos com vida?
verses.en_web: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing, and have saved the boys alive?”
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Egypt sent for the women, and said to them, Why have you done this, and let the male children go on living?

verses.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
verses.pt: Responderam as parteiras a Faraó: É que as mulheres hebréias não são como as egípcias; pois são vigorosas, e já têm dado à luz antes que a parteira chegue a elas.
verses.en_web: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous, and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are strong, and the birth takes place before we come to them.

verses.en: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
verses.pt: Portanto Deus fez bem às parteiras. E o povo se aumentou, e se fortaleceu muito.
verses.en_web: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.
verses.en_bbe: And the blessing of God was on these women: and the people were increased in number and became very strong.

verses.en: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
verses.pt: Também aconteceu que, como as parteiras temeram a Deus, ele lhes estabeleceu as casas.
verses.en_web: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.
verses.en_bbe: And because the women who took care of the Hebrew mothers had the fear of God, he gave them families.

verses.en: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
verses.pt: Então ordenou Faraó a todo o seu povo, dizendo: A todos os filhos que nascerem lançareis no rio, mas a todas as filhas guardareis com vida.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh gave orders to all his people, saying, Every son who comes to birth is to be put into the river, but every daughter may go on living.
